description: Check whether fiber internet is available at a street address. Fast Fibre is an independent local service in Hinesville & Richmond Hill, GA; the fiber network is Brightspeed's. Free, no sign-up. Returns the status, a summary to tell the person, the speeds the block can get and whether a call can be requested. Prices are never quoted online: a specialist tells them on the call.

street.description: House number and street, e.g. "511 Azalea St"
